title: Buggy after five years of use
text: I’ve used this app for over five years now and every year is always something new random bug which results in my reinstalling the app I have no idea why. The past two days the app keeps auto pausing my runs despite having the option off. Like yesterday was if I left the app it pauses, today if I just have the app running and shut off my screen it pauses the run, literally the most idiotic bugs that always arises. Literally had to turn on Strava halfway thru the run bc there was no way to fix the auto pausing issue. Never left a review for any of the other bugs but this is infuriating me, literally the whole point of the app is to track my run and if it can’t do that I’m done.

title: It’s ruined for now
text: I’ve used Nike Run Club for years, but recently it has started consistently undercounting my runs by 2–3% and has stopped recording cadence altogether. I’ve compared identical established routes: a route NRC previously measured at 4.08 miles now records as 3.95, despite nearly identical GPS maps. Apple Health confirms my Apple Watch is still recording step data, yet NRC shows no cadence. I’ve checked every relevant permission, reset calibration, reinstalled the app multiple times, and nothing fixes it. Accurate distance and pace are the most basic functions of a running app. Please fix this.

title: Приложение на телефоне не подгружает итоги пробежке, запущенной на Apple watch
text: Запустил пробежке через Nike run club на apple watch. Пробежал, остановил тренировку. Через пару часов приложение nike run club на телефоне не подгружает итоги пробежки, запущенной на Apple watch. Уже и Apple Fitness всё отображает, а NRC на телефоне показывает только пробежки прошлой недели. Какая то шляпа! Мне социальные функции не нужны, лучше уж strava. Платные функции не нужны. Но не работоспособность в качестве логгера разочаровывает. Похоже, придётся удалять эту шнягу.

title: Apple Watch Integration
text: Went back and forth for 20 minutes trying to get the app to sync easily to my watch. Once synced the guided run audio kept going away any time I opened another app. I think the actual run plans may be good but may not be able to use because of these issues.

title: 8 digit code takes 2 hours
text: I love this app. But it stopped syncing with Strava after my phone battery died in the middle of a run.  I have reinstalled the app (and, unfortunately, expect to lose my run data) but I am not able to log in because the 8 digit codes are taking between 30 minutes and 120 minutes to land in my inbox.

title: Doesn’t measure distance worth a darn
text: It used to work ok, but now it doesn’t measure distance at ALL. Deleting app.

title: good app but there is room for improvement
text:
Please please please this is not a difficult fix - more variety for the backgrounds when creating a challenge! Allow use of own photos or just add a few. They’ve been the same four since I joined 15 years ago. I mean seriously Nike.

I have been using the Run app since 2011. My best friend and I travel a lot
so we often are on different continents. The challenge allows us to still run together and that’s awesome. But please - those encouragement audios at the end of a run - they’ve been the same for ages, years. Surely AI could make it possible for some updated customized cheers at the end.

title: Broken notifications and cheers
text:
Notifications and sending cheers is broken. Users don’t get cheers during their run, and audio message cheers are unable to be dismissed when viewed from the inbox. That requires the app to be force quit. 
Separately, it is also annoying that warm-up, recovery intervals are not counted towards the total mileage, when I’m still running during that time.

title: Has Nike Given Up on This App?
text:
It seems like absolutely nothing is coming out of Nike lately when it comes to improving this app. It’s become increasingly buggy, run tracking has been terrible, GPS isn’t locking in properly, and the syncing process is slower than ever.

I know there have been layoffs within Nike’s digital team, but if Nike has given up on this app, please let us know so we can start looking for alternatives.

It’s such a shame because this has always been such a friendly, useful, and beloved app. Now it feels like nobody is supporting or maintaining it.

If revenue is the issue, I honestly wouldn’t mind paying up to $2.99 per month for a subscription if it meant getting a reliable, regularly updated app that takes full advantage of the latest devices, including the Apple Watch Ultra 4 and iPhone Duo.

Nike is such an iconic company, and it’s disappointing to see an app that has been so important to runners seemingly neglected. We don’t need flashy new features. We need accurate GPS, reliable tracking, faster syncing, and consistent updates.

Please don’t abandon this app. Your loyal users deserve better.

title: Nice but missing something
text: Nice clean app with no ads which is great. However, if you’re using the training plans the interval training does not automatically track itself forcing you to look down at your phone or watch to track yourself which is just kind of annoying.

title: Cuts miles off
text: My past 3 runs have been cut short by this app. All the other runners who use the strava app have the same distance. Mine have been cut short up to a mile.

title: Buggy, bad with time zone changes
text:
After the app automatically pauses my run, for instance at a stoplight, and restarts, the screen on my watch is blank. From that point on I have to rely only on audio clues. 
When I run on trips the time zone in the app doesn’t properly reflect the times I ran. The runs are all still in my home time zone.

title: So inaccurate
text: The mileage is so inaccurate and it doesn’t let you edit- so frustrating

title: No real coaching for beginners
text: When I first saw the app, I expected actual coaching. On my very first run, Niko talked to me, eventually asked if I was running, and said I should be. There are no intervals and no guidance at all. You're just expected to run and stay motivated on your own. Other apps ease you in: run for one minute, walk for two, run another minute, and gradually build up. This one just tells you to start running, even if you have no experience. Not a good fit for beginners.

title: Junk
text: Had me running four minutes per mile faster than I actually was and distances was .4 miles too long. Was in open urban area with no GPS blockage and Precise Location set in Privacy settings. strava ftw

title: Broken
text: Sync issues deleted an entire week of running data. Screen will blank out on apple watch after auto pausing at a light. Random crashes. Low effort updates (still have challenges from over a year ago they never bothered to clean up). Used to be a really solid app but its been going downhill hard, not sure how much longer it’s worth tolerating before switching to something else…

title: Inaccurate
text: My apple watch was tracking my mile run, as well as the app. My watch tracked 1.02 miles, which is accurate for the trail I run on. This app tracked 0.93 miles, which is a good bit lower than it should be. I will find alternative apps, because this one has disappointed me.

title: Error parsing response from server
text: Can’t login and lost all my saved runs going back years and years. I’m heartbroken

title: Upgrade
text:
I’ve been using this app for over 10 years, but it’s seen very few meaningful updates or upgrades during that time. Other running apps offer much stronger features and ways to connect. I’d love to see similar improvements here, including useful features like satellite maps and chat capabilities.

I enjoy using the app, but I think it’s time for a refresh. Nike has made great improvements to the Training app, and now the Nike Run app deserves some love, too.

title: Terrible GPS
text: My “3 mile” run ended up being 2.1 miles confirmed by mapmyrun and my vehicles trip meter.

title: PLEASE UPDATE THE APP
text: I get logged out of the app AT LEAST once a week. Today it happened and I all of my data from my run disappeared. Super disappointed in this. It has been happening for years! This app could be better than Strava but it is lacking.

title: crashes often
text: Can’t use the app all time

title: Challenges need work

title: Latest version on Apple Watch Ultra 4 is terrible
text: I’ve been using this app for many years on multiple Apple Watches but this latest version on the watch is terrible. It commits the absolute mortal sin- running a multiple mile run, clicking on stop to save it, and it vanishes…. Gone for good… deserves a class action lawsuit….its happened to me 3 times in 2 weeks.

title: They have finally, FINALLY started working on making it functional.
text: Still has a ways to go but I’m hopeful. One obvious flaw: currently can’t install or uninstall via the iPhone Apple Watch app. Have to install from the Apple Watch App Store app or “physically” delete it from the AW to uninstall. Basic stuff like this really makes me wonder abt its continued development but the recent additions of ways to save Guided Runs and to filter by run type, although literally a decade late to the party 🙄, are a good sign.

title: Nile update
text: I’m still missing my Nike run miles I was at volt now back at level why come on Nike do better!

title: I’m trying to like it
text: JFC I’m trying. I really am. The app is buggy. It won’t let me listen to music. It won’t download new runs. It doesn’t let me make calls or text using Siri while the app is open. I just wanted something to help motivate my run, and track my progress. This isn’t it. Not by a long shot. I really thought with NIKE’s budget, they’d be able to get this right. They did not.

title: Wiped! 6 years of Running Data
text:
After using Nike’s app for years and documenting all of my runs, I was frustrated to say the least to open it one day and discover my data was gone. My running records and stats over the past 6 years completely disappeared. I assumed it may be a bug / technical issue. 

But contacting customer service has been far from pleasant. After calls and emails I have a single repeated response asking if there’s “another email address” I’ve used that they can search for me. No empathy, no technical understanding, just a condescending assumption that I forgot my email address and password. 

What’s the point of a training app if you can’t trust it to track your records.

title: 8 digit code
text: The app never sent the 8 digit code to login. Is frustrating to lose all my runs !!!

title: Great guided runs, terrible GPS
text: I credit this app for helping me to get back into running! I’ve really enjoyed the guided runs, and how I can listen to my own music underneath. But the GPS is so bad. It’s very inconsistent. I’ve started using Strava simultaneously and the Nike gps always gives false metrics. Today I ran a 22 minute guided run (for the whole length of the run) but it recorded all of my distance as 11 minutes. Which is impossible. All to say, love the guided runs, can’t use the tracking.

title: Stop pausing
text: App pauses and unpauses continuously while running with stroller. I don’t have pockets, I shouldn’t have to buy an accessory. It is anti woman.

title: Runs not syncing

title: Unreliable on Apple Watch
text:
I’ve used NRC on iPhone for 10+ years with no issues, but ever since updating my Apple software, the Apple Watch app has been crashing and glitching constantly.
During one run, the screen on my watch went black after I paused my run yet it continued recording, so I couldn’t see my mileage, time, or heart rate. Even worse, it crashed at the start of an important race, forcing me to use my phone instead! It’s frustrating to see the watch experience become so unstable after a software update. After a month of these issues, I’m seriously considering switching to another running app. Please fix this!
